title: agent.failed (v1)
description: Cross-cutting event: an agent failed in some way. Triggers ResearchOrchestrator's agent-failure-routing cross-cutting layer (transient/permanent/policy_violation branches).

agent_name.description: Which agent failed. ResearchOrchestrator itself is excluded (it is the consumer, not an emitter of agent.failed).

reason_classification.description: How the failure should be routed. transient -> retry with a retry counter. permanent -> route to a user/human decision point. policy_violation -> MOSS first time, escalate second.

underlying_reason.description: Free-form description of why the agent failed (e.g. 'LLM 5xx', 'output malformed', 'timeout'). Used for diagnostics and MOSS analysis.

violation_type.description: Only present when reason_classification == 'policy_violation'. Used as part of the policy_violation_history key (agent_name, violation_type).
